title: Cascading errors in user-service following notification-service rollout
user_facing_impact: ~30% of user-facing requests degraded; users see errors on notification-linked flows.
symptom_summary: user-service error rate spiked to ~30% at 08:03 UTC. user-service has had NO deployment since v3.3.1 (2024-06-20); its code is unchanged in this window.

timeline.event: notification-service deployed v2.1.0 (digest-scheduler rewrite) to production
user-service error rate begins climbing (downstream failures from notification callbacks)
notification-service v2.1.0 confirmed emitting malformed callbacks that user-service rejects

root_cause: notification-service v2.1.0 (deployed 08:00) emits malformed digest callbacks; user-service rejects them and its error rate climbs. user-service itself is unchanged.
contributing_factors: digest-scheduler rewrite shipped without a canary
user-service dashboards alarm louder than notification-service
